theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.entire_zero_count {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (S : Finset ℂ) (hfne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, z ∉ S → f z ≠ 0) (hS : ↑S = {z : ℂ | z ∈ Metric.ball c R ∧ (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R)) z ≠ 0}) :
((2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), logDeriv f z) = ↑(zeroCount (fun (z : ℂ) => (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R)) z) S)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.argument_principle {f : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hf : MeromorphicOn f (Metric.closedBall c R)) (S : Finset ℂ) (hfU : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (Metric.closedBall c R \ ↑S)) (hfne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c R, z ∉ S → f z ≠ 0) (hS : ↑S = {z : ℂ | z ∈ Metric.ball c R ∧ (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R)) z ≠ 0}) :
((2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), logDeriv f z) = ↑(∑ w ∈ S, (MeromorphicOn.divisor f (Metric.closedBall c R)) w)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.circleIntegral_sum_simple_poles {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (T : Finset ℂ) (a : ℂ → ℂ) (hT : ∀ u ∈ T, u ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), ∑ u ∈ T, a u * (z - u)⁻¹) = ∑ u ∈ T, a u * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.circleIntegrable_sum_simple_poles {c : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (T : Finset ℂ) (a : ℂ → ℂ) (hT : ∀ u ∈ T, u ∈ Metric.ball c R) :
CircleIntegrable (fun (z : ℂ) => ∑ u ∈ T, a u * (z - u)⁻¹) c R

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.residue_logDeriv_eq_order {f : ℂ → ℂ} {w : ℂ} {r : ℝ} {n : ℤ} {U : Set ℂ} (hf : MeromorphicAt f w) (hr : 0 < r) (hU_open : IsOpen U) (hball_sub : Metric.closedBall w r ⊆ U) (horder : meromorphicOrderAt f w = ↑n) (hfU : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (U \ {w})) (hfne : ∀ z ∈ U, z ≠ w → f z ≠ 0) :
((2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(w, r), logDeriv f z) = ↑n

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.circleIntegral_logDeriv_eq_zero_of_analyticOnNhd {g : ℂ → ℂ} {w : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Metric.closedBall w r)) (hgne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall w r, g z ≠ 0) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(w, r), logDeriv g z) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.inv_two_pi_I_mul_integral_nat_sub_center_inv {w : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (n : ℤ) :
((2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(w, r), ↑n * (z - w)⁻¹) = ↑n

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.logDeriv_zpow_sub_mul_split {g : ℂ → ℂ} {w z : ℂ} {n : ℤ} (hz : z ≠ w) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℂ g z) (hgz : g z ≠ 0) :
logDeriv (fun (ζ : ℂ) => (ζ - w) ^ n * g ζ) z = ↑n * (z - w)⁻¹ + logDeriv g z

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.two_pi_I_ne_zero' :
2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.zeroCount_sub_poleCount_eq_sum_divisor (D : ℂ → ℤ) (S : Finset ℂ) :
↑(zeroCount D S) - ↑(poleCount D S) = ∑ w ∈ S, D w

ℕ

def QOU.Mathlib.ArgumentPrinciple.zeroCount (D : ℂ → ℤ) (S : Finset ℂ) :
ℕ
